annotations.title: Remove a person from the company

description: DESTRUCTIVE and cannot be undone: removes a person from the company. A joined member loses access to the company and its signature; a pending invitation is withdrawn with the details entered for it. Confirm with the user before calling. Company owners only. Nobody can remove themselves or the primary owner.
